description: Submit your peer review of a classmate's work: a comment and, optionally, rubric scores. The classmate and instructor can see it. Get student_id from list_my_peer_reviews. [NEEDS CONFIRMATION: call it once for a preview and a confirm_token, show the preview to the user, and only if they say yes call it again with the same arguments, confirm=true and that confirm_token. Apps that can ask the user directly show a confirmation instead.]

assignment_id.description: Assignment ID (numeric string). Get it from list_assignments or list_upcoming_assignments.

comment.description: Your review comment. The classmate and your instructor can see it.

confirm.description: Set to true together with confirm_token to carry out a request you already previewed.

confirm_token.description: The one-time token from the preview. Only use it after the user has said yes.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

rubric_assessment.description: Optional rubric scores keyed by criterion ID, e.g. {"_1234": {"points": 4, "comments": "Clear thesis"}}. Get criterion IDs from get_rubric.

student_id.description: The student whose work you are reviewing

name: submit_peer_review
title: Submit Peer Review
